name: Semantic stress sites v1 - unscored-by-Refero cases that exercise specific extractor failure modes
method: Candidates proposed per category, then every candidate probed live (site-probe.mjs: pre-scroll DOM evidence at 1280x800 plus viewport screenshot) and judged by an independent agent against numeric criteria and the screenshot. Rejected candidates are listed so the search is reproducible.

references.title: Opus One Winery
references.why: First-screen hero is a photograph delivered as a CSS background-image, not an .
references.evidence: preScroll.topMedia[0] = css-background, ext jpg, viewportArea 880640; buttons 0px x7, 2px x4.

references.title: Auberge Resorts
references.why: First-screen hero is a photograph delivered as a <video poster>; redirects to auberge.com.
references.evidence: preScroll.topMedia[0] = video-poster frame_86400.jpg, viewportArea 913920; buttons 0px x116, 50% x4.

references.title: Linear
references.why: Product-screenshot-led hero; image URLs are Next.js /_next/image paths with no extension, so extension heuristics see nothing.
references.evidence: preScroll.topMedia: img ext none 491520, css-background png 310503, img ext none 277120; fonts Inter Variable, Berkeley Mono.

references.title: Spline
references.why: 3D-render hero drawn on WebGL canvases with no raster media on the first screen; the extractor must not report photography.
references.evidence: preScroll bigCanvas 3; largest raster img on screen is a 1024 px2 logo; carousel webps are off-screen (viewportArea 0).

references.title: Wise
references.why: Pill-shaped primary CTA system: 9999px radius on the majority of buttons.
references.evidence: preScroll.radii.buttons = 9999px x41, 18.359px x28, 0px x1 (58.6% pill); screenshot shows stadium CTAs.

references.title: Monzo
references.why: Pill-shaped primary CTA system plus a photographic avif hero.
references.evidence: preScroll.radii.buttons = 128px x32, 16px x9, 0px x3, 100px x1 (73.3% pill); hero avif viewportArea 774216.

coveredInsideCorpus.extensionless-cdn-photography: n26.com serves 11 of 17 first-screen images through extensionless /_next/image paths; mercury.com's 1023620 px2 hero is extensionless; linear.app above adds a screenshot-led case.
